contexts.text: Then shall many be offended, and shall deliver up one another, and shall hate one another = enmities on account of these things. Many shall be offended = the enmity in themselves; the Lord's Human itself is that which excites the enmity... They shall deliver up one another = the enmity among themselves from falsity against truth; and they shall hate one another = the enmity among themselves from evil against good.
Still less, enmity against the goods and truths of faith...
A sphere of enmity against the Lord...
From the love of the world there also arise enmities and hatreds, but in a less degree.
They made human prudence to consist in exciting enmities... for the sake of exercising command. SE 1793.
From these principles he lives... in enmity and hatred against everyone who does not worship him...
(The effort of the Hells to infest the good) is enmity, which continually breathes hostility and violence...
From the love of self there springs forth... enmity if they do not favour...
The evils derived from these two loves, are... enmity and hostility against those who do not favour them...
In these (western) Hells are those who in the world had been in the love of self, and thence in... enmity against those who did not favour them...
By murders of every kind are also meant every kind of enmity... TCR 309. AE 1012:3.
I will put enmity between thee and the woman ()... The enmity which exists between the love belonging to man's proprium, and the Lord...
With the consummate hypocrite there is an intestine enmity against truly spiritual men...
The evils with those who are in the love of dominion from the love of self, are in general... enmity against those who do not favour them; hostility thence...
There is a natural enmity... A like enmity have all men here against reason...
The nations were angry = the... enmity and hatred of the evil against the Lord...
Hatred exists especially with those who are in the love of exercising command over all: with the rest there is enmity.
